title: NutriVision: Ingredient-Conditioned Fusion and Prediction for Single-Image Food Nutrition Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2609.33076v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Nutrition estimation is a fundamental task in consumer diet tracking, clinical dietetics, chronic disease management, sports and hospital nutrition, and broader food computing systems. The existing approaches have progressed along two largely separate axes, vision models that rely on calibrated RGB-depth captures and ingredient-aware methods that use textual cues but use limited multimodal fusion. We introduce NutriVision, an end-to-end framework that leverages visual geometry and ingredient semantics to estimate calories, mass, fat content, carbohydrates, and protein from a single RGB image and an optional ingredient list. It obtains the unavailable depth modality using DepthAnything-V3 and encodes ingredient descriptions using CLIP. It integrates three complementary mechanisms: (1) an \emph{Ingredient-Conditioned Frequency-Aligned Fusion Module (IC-FAFM)}, which uses textual guidance to reweight and align RGB-depth frequency

translated_title: NutriVision：基于食材条件化融合与预测的单图像食物营养估计
translated_abstract: 营养估计是消费者饮食追踪、临床营养学、慢性病管理、运动与医院营养以及更广泛的食品计算系统中的一项基础任务。现有方法沿两条基本独立的方向发展：一类是依赖校准RGB-深度采集的视觉模型，另一类是利用文本线索但多模态融合有限的食材感知方法。我们提出了NutriVision，一个端到端框架，它利用视觉几何与食材语义，从单张RGB图像和可选的食材列表中估计卡路里、质量、脂肪含量、碳水化合物和蛋白质。该方法使用DepthAnything-V3获取原本不可用的深度模态，并使用CLIP编码食材描述。它集成了三种互补机制：（1）食材条件化频率对齐融合模块（IC-FAFM），利用文本引导对RGB-深度频率进行重新加权和对齐……
tldr: NutriVision是一个端到端营养估计框架，通过DepthAnything-V3生成深度信息并结合CLIP编码的食材语义，借助食材条件化频率对齐融合模块（IC-FAFM），从单张RGB图像和可选食材列表中估计食物的卡路里、质量、脂肪、碳水化合物和蛋白质。
en_tdlr: NutriVision is an end-to-end framework that estimates calories, mass, fat, carbohydrates, and protein from a single RGB image and an optional ingredient list by fusing visual geometry (DepthAnything-V3 depth) with ingredient semantics (CLIP encoding) via an Ingredient-Conditioned Frequency-Aligned Fusion Module.
